rules.title: Attendance
rules.body: Attend scheduled sessions and follow the course attendance process.

rules.title: Assignment submissions
rules.body: Submit work through the course workspace before the published deadline.

rules.title: Practice
rules.body: Use practice activities to build skills; practice scores do not change official grades unless an assessment says otherwise.

rules.title: Assessments
rules.body: Follow the instructions and timing shown on each published assessment.

rules.title: Classroom conduct
rules.body: Treat classmates and staff respectfully and do not submit another person's work as your own.

rules.title: Communication
rules.body: Use the course communication channels for course-related questions and announcements.
